name: Early-stage startup internship via gmail
why: No money is requested and a real interview is promised, but the recruiter uses a gmail address, offers WhatsApp contact and the company has no verifiable careers page. Risk without a direct fraud indicator = Suspicious, not Likely scam.

case.message:
Hi Rohan,

I'm Priya, co-founder of Nexora Analytics, an early-stage startup in Bengaluru working on retail demand forecasting. We came across your GitHub profile and would love to talk to you about a remote Data Analyst Intern role (6 months, stipend Rs 15,000 per month).

We're a small team so we don't have a formal careers page yet. If you're interested, please share your resume on WhatsApp at +91 98765 01234 or email us at nexora.hiring@gmail.com, and we'll set up a 30-minute video interview next week.

Website: nexora-analytics-labs.in

Thanks,
Priya
